title: MOTO RUSH
one_line: Race a 3D superbike through traffic, boost with nitro, chain near misses and chase the longest run.
how_to_play: Touch the left or right side of the screen to steer, hold NITRO to boost, and pass close to cars for near-miss bonuses.
description: Ride beyond limits in a 3D motorcycle rush. Dodge endless traffic across sunset coast, neon night, desert and alpine roads. Squeeze past cars for near-miss combos and free nitro, take on the Daily Run (the same road for everyone, with a streak), and spend coins on new bike colours.
